t: 法国军队由吉斯公爵弗朗西斯率领,夺取了英格兰最后的大陆占有地加来.
te: French troops, led by Francis, Duke of Guise, take Calais, the last continental possession of England.
dz: 法国军队由吉斯公爵弗朗西斯率领,夺取了英格兰最后的大陆占有地加来.
de: French troops, led by Francis, Duke of Guise, take Calais, the last continental possession of England.

t: 波里市(瑞典文:Björneborg)由约翰公爵在波尔尼亚湾沿岸建立.
te: The city of Pori (Swedish: Björneborg) is founded by Duke John on the shores of the Gulf of Bothnia.
dz: 波里市(瑞典文:Björneborg)由约翰公爵在波尔尼亚湾沿岸建立.
de: The city of Pori (Swedish: Björneborg) is founded by Duke John on the shores of the Gulf of Bothnia.

t: 玛丽,苏格兰王后,与法国的道芬·弗朗索瓦(英语:Dauphin of France, Fran…
te: Mary, Queen of Scots, marries the Dauphin of France, François, at Notre-Dame de Paris.
dz: 玛丽,苏格兰王后,与法国的道芬·弗朗索瓦(英语:Dauphin of France, François)于巴黎圣母院结婚.
de: Mary, Queen of Scots, marries the Dauphin of France, François, at Notre-Dame de Paris.

t: 在法国,由埃格蒙特伯爵拉莫勒所率领的西班牙军队在格雷夫林斯击败了由法军元帅保罗·德·特尔梅斯所…
te: In France, Spanish forces led by Count Lamoral of Egmont defeat the French forces of Marshal Paul de Thermes at Graveli…
dz: 格雷夫林斯战役:在法国,由埃格蒙特伯爵拉莫勒所率领的西班牙军队在格雷夫林斯击败了由法军元帅保罗·德·特尔梅斯所领导的法军.
de: Battle of Gravelines: In France, Spanish forces led by Count Lamoral of Egmont defeat the French forces of Marshal Paul de Thermes at Gravelines.

t: 波克兹塔·波尔斯卡(波克兹塔·波尔斯卡)是波兰的邮政服务机构,成立.
te: Poczta Polska, the Polish postal service, is founded.
dz: 波克兹塔·波尔斯卡(波克兹塔·波尔斯卡)是波兰的邮政服务机构,成立.
de: Poczta Polska, the Polish postal service, is founded.

t: 英格兰女王玛丽一世去世后由同父异母的妹妹伊丽莎白一世接任.
te: Queen Mary I of England dies and is succeeded by her half-sister Elizabeth I.
dz: 伊丽莎白时代开始:英格兰女王玛丽一世去世后由同父异母的妹妹伊丽莎白一世接任.
de: Elizabethan era begins: Queen Mary I of England dies and is succeeded by her half-sister Elizabeth I.
